description: This file defines an immutable Java record class `GLAccountCommand` for representing commands related to creating or updating a general ledger account in the system. It includes validation logic for the input data during creation and update operations, ensuring adherence to business rules and constraints.

classes.name: GLAccountCommand
classes.description: An immutable record class encapsulating the parameters for creating or updating a general ledger account, along with validation methods to enforce business rules.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the fields of the command object for creating a new general ledger account, throwing an exception if any validation rules are violated.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the fields of the command object for updating an existing general ledger account, allowing for partial updates with null values.

methods.name: isHeaderAccount
methods.description: Determines if the account usage indicates a header account based on the usage value.
